author: Kif Leswing
title: All NYPD officers will get work iPhones - and one cop calls it 'the ultimate tool' (AAPL)
text: All NYPD officers will get work iPhones — and one cop calls it 'the ultimate tool' (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Feb 5, 2018, 4:50 pm 6 pts New York police officers will be able to choose from a department-issued iPhone 7 or iPhone 7 Plus. It's part of a $160 million program that will give every police officer a smartphone. NYPD used to use Nokia phones running Windows Phone. New York police officers patrol the streets of the city…
